_comment: Real sources for the Food Waste Reducer. No secrets. class_map keys = SOURCE labels; value = canonical taxonomy name, 'name:spoiled'/'name:fresh' to force freshness, or null to drop. Sources with "pending": true (or a missing root) are skipped by prepare_dataset.py (none pending now). 'max_per_class' caps images per class x freshness for 'folders' sources. Roots are outside the repo under mldata/. 'drop_image_if_label' drops an entire image if it contains any listed unmodelled object (so it is not left unlabeled). 'series_grouping': true groups numbered camera series (name_3, name_4, ...) into one split group; default is one group per original photo.

sources.name: vegqual
sources._note: Gourds are not taxonomy classes. 1615 of 4831 images are gourd-only (dropped automatically: no mapped boxes). 6 images mix gourds with other vegs; drop_image_if_label removes those so no gourd is left unlabeled.

sources.name: fridge_objects
sources._note: Roboflow v1, 963 images (train 731 / valid 125 / test 107), exported as yolov5pytorch (same YOLO txt layout). Names verified against data.yaml: avocado, bacon, butter, cheese, eggs, lemon, milk, pepper, tomatoes, yogurt. No freshness info: all boxes are assumed fresh (detector only, no classifier crops).

sources.name: hien_fridge
sources._note: Roboflow v12, 1,912 images (train 1378 / valid 363 / test 171), exported as yolov8. Names verified against data.yaml: apple, egg, milk_carton, others, soda_can, yogurt_container. 'others' is dropped (box only, image kept). All boxes assumed fresh.

sources.name: fresh_stale_fruits_veg
sources._note: Kaggle raghavrpotdar/fresh-and-stale-images-of-fruits-and-vegetables, CC0 1.0, folder-per-class, 14,683 files (fresh_/stale_ x apple, banana, bitter_gourd, capsicum, orange, tomato). stale -> spoiled, capsicum -> bell_pepper, bitter_gourd dropped (whole image; not a taxonomy class, bitter_melon comes in a later PR). Files are augmentations ('name.jpg_0_1039.jpg') of far fewer originals and are grouped by original name; 'Screen Shot <date> at <time>' names give capture times. max_per_class=250 caps images per class x freshness (after the cap about 2,500 images, so it does not swamp VegQual 3.2k / fridge 2.9k).
sources.version_note: Kaggle dataset; no version number exposed (record download date 2026-10-10).
